A01.title: Select the native language and establish the build
A01.observation: C++23 decision/CMake presets and warnings are concrete; parser archive/header inputs are locked. Actual second-compiler and clean-source records exist, with explicit historical source vintages.

A02.title: Pin and document source baselines
A02.observation: Both repository commits and paper versions, exact file/design provenance and separate source/build/experiment fields are documented. Only project licensing disposition is user-deferred; no licensing permission is inferred.

A03.title: Freeze semantics and feature admission
A03.observation: The classical core determines physical set/no-op/identity, nullary Boolean, ordered transport, NULL/type/arithmetic refusal and owning outputs; current interfaces preserve separate set, bag, aggregate and difference types.

A04.title: Build an independent exact relational oracle
A04.observation: The reference enumerator uses ordinary assignment joins and projection, independent of planner/support/cursors; its Session prepares before/after sets privately. Later Python reference multiplicities are arbitrary-precision integers.

A05.title: Build trace/query generators and failure shrinking
A05.observation: Seeded independent shape/data generation checks validity. The ddmin shrinker fixes query/catalog/value domains while minimizing rows/updates; failure packets retain SQL, parameters, normalized CQ, seed and full/minimal trace.

C01.title: Collect useful statistics with bounded overhead
C01.observation: Bounded actual-owner cardinality/NDV/degree/heavy-key captures and transactional physical workload strata distinguish exact/sampled/unknown/stale/private/saturated values. Collection costs and native account memory are measured explicitly.

C02.title: Implement height-constrained baseline plan ranking
C02.observation: Height-only, actual-input native-depth and tuple/index-slot ranking consume original proof-bearing candidates before scoring. Exact rational/integer decompositions and source/freshness/budget failures are visible; contradiction repair retains original structural height while the empty physical operator costs zero.

C03.title: Implement the maintenance cost model
C03.observation: Candidate-bound conditional event counts/touched-bucket sums, raw calibration or declared fitted assumptions, exact decomposed ratios and confidence/availability fields separate maintenance from annotation/full/delta/encoding/checkpoint demand. Memory is a byte budget, not an unexplained mixed-unit score.

C04.title: Add a meta-decomposition candidate adapter
C04.observation: The optional source-grounded adapter expands ordinary meta families and then exhaustive generalized/head-aware inverse fibers. Every candidate passes original-bound P02/proved-height/key gates; upstream ordinary/fiber/provider exhaustion stays separate, and no global cost optimum is claimed.

C05.title: Select physical plans under explicit policies
C05.observation: Default selection is deterministic proof-first lexicographic C02 ranking over an explicit finite candidate policy, layout and source/context/cache key. Logical slot ceilings work; unsupported optional maintenance-cost policy/allocator-byte forecasts refuse explicitly rather than bypassing structural admission.

C06.title: Implement barrier-based reoptimization
C06.observation: Same-account cold rebuild keeps old and target states, records ordered catch-up, compares exact source/results, then publishes at a durable barrier with old-plan recovery retained until selection. Measured rebuild/catch-up/equivalence/publication/cleanup and dual-state memory feed explicit forecast/hysteresis/payback.

C07.title: Validate ranking on held-out traces
C07.observation: Disjoint training/calibration/evaluation traces freeze choices and calibrated mappings before held-out runs. Actual feasible-candidate preflights/raw timings, measured regret and estimate errors are independently checked under mix/fan-out shifts; worse weighted-depth outcomes remain visible.

F01.title: Implement the catalog and scalar semantics
F01.observation: Catalog constraints, statistics and hints have separate structures/status. Exact typed int/string/bool/date/decimal equality/hash and fixed Decimal specifications precede classical non-null admission.

F02.title: Wrap the SQL syntax parser
F02.observation: Pinned libpg_query is wrapped in noncopyable ParseOwner with unconditional free. Strict UTF-8/NUL/statement/source limits and locations are distinct from later admission.

F03.title: Implement binding and SQL desugaring
F03.observation: Binder resolves named scopes and aliases, expands USING/NATURAL/star from actual catalog metadata and preserves ordered/repeated output/EXISTS wrapping; physical aliases remain distinct occurrences.

F04.title: Normalize equality CQs and local adapters
F04.observation: Normalization merges checked equality classes after casts/NULL filtering, retains every mutable occurrence, explicit local adapters and constant/contradiction/output mappings. Cross-relation predicates refuse equality admission or use a separate comparison API.

F05.title: Version and validate CQ/plan schemas
F05.observation: Versioned schemas/readers reject unknown/incompatible input and replay complete source bindings. Canonical semantic/output/cost identities are address-independent; upgrades are explicit and old versions remain separately replayed.

F06.title: Implement admission diagnostics and SQL integration tests
F06.observation: Integrated parse/bind/normalize/classification distinguishes syntax, semantic/unsupported semantics, cyclic, non-free-connex, resource stop and explicit empty admission. Plain bag SELECT never silently becomes DISTINCT; explicit later row/fallback interfaces have separate profiles.

P01.title: Recognize alpha-acyclicity and free-connexity
P01.observation: GYO copies occurrence-labelled scopes, checks H and H+F independently, returns replayable reductions/failed cores, and never creates an executable head relation. Independent undirected join-tree enumeration covers the stated finite family.

P02.title: Implement the independent tree verifier
P02.observation: Independent validation establishes rooted topology, exact native cover/scope, Connect, each child Guard, Above, computed separators/maximal C* and separate height/depth. Invalid properties carry witnesses; it confers an upper bound only.

P03.title: Implement the finite complete tree oracle
P03.observation: The literal normal-form oracle enumerates labelled topologies/all native power-set scopes through m-1 generalized nodes; the partition recurrence is independently replayed. Normal-form contraction/connex proof and residual minima3 are retained, and resource stops are not infeasibility.

P04.title: Implement safe fast paths and exact search improvements
P04.observation: Fast paths and pruning are limited to proved hierarchy/singleton/constant/disconnected/symmetry cases with independent lower replay and P03 differential fixtures. Dynamic scopes have explicit resource ceilings rather than hard semantic arity/fan-out caps.

P05.title: Audit and repair residual-based candidate construction
P05.observation: Frozen eligible ears/anchors and induced heads are replayed independently. Greedy native/generalized/graft reconstruction is explicitly a candidate family; failed prefix construction uses full-original exact repair. Only completed original-bound P06 evidence supplies a minimum.

P06.title: Implement exactness evidence and search budgets
P06.observation: Owned resumable producer/P02/lower replay continuations keep a checked incumbent distinct from an immutable verified optimum/infeasibility handle. Strict versus best-found policy, bound intervals, work/time/depth/cancel/monotone extension and corrupted certificate checks are concrete.

P07.title: Enumerate and cache alternative admissible plans
P07.observation: CandidateProvider keeps the original VerifiedOptimum while independently checking/deduplicating alternative uppers at that minimum. Dynamic normal-form enumeration, family/provenance/exhaustion and exact-binding cache fences preserve catalogs/heads/context/arithmetic.

P08.title: Lower validated trees to physical plans
P08.observation: Factory-only immutable physical plans compile numeric layouts/projections/shared separator indices/ports/C* enumeration and guarantee data. Lowering independently checks the supplied tree and original normalized source; it creates an upper plan, not an optimum or query-specific registration.

S01.title: Define typed IDs, layouts and key projection programs
S01.observation: Central typed identifiers and immutable layout/projection tokens compile numeric composite/reordered/repeated/empty keys. Exact typed scalar comparisons/hash keep bool/int and Decimal/date domains distinct; wide projection fixtures avoid field-name inner lookups.

S02.title: Implement a simple reference storage backend
S02.observation: The standard-container reference backend owns primary/separator indices, live cursors and owning snapshots behind the same contract. Independent map-of-sets models and allocation-failure checks exercise duplicate/absent and key deletion behavior.

S03.title: Implement tuple arenas and stable handles
S03.observation: Noncopyable arenas retain owner/slot/generation identity and move-only pins. Live/free slots, stale handles, clear/destruction/reuse and failed allocation are checked; pinned payloads survive logical deletion and owner facade lifetime.

S04.title: Add optimized primary and secondary indices
S04.observation: Primary/hash-key directories, collision seams and intrusive live row/bucket membership are integer-exact and separate from annotations. One finite five-domain grant covers nested/resumed operations, while comparison/reference and >2^53/live-walk/fault cases remain registered.

S05.title: Enforce capacity, overflow and memory accounting
S05.observation: Checked native accounts include actual requested allocation headers/alignment and component/purpose/lifetime attribution, under the original receiving query cap. Prepared publication/rollback needs no new allocation; reports reconcile real operator records. Caller/compiler/export boundaries and allowed retained/high-water state are explicit.
